name: fade_render_channel_out

stack.evidence: func_001DB0C8 passes the earlier stack value as the render-channel index and the top value as the duration to func_00108488, then decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_00108488 indexes one of 32 twelve-byte transition records in D_0048E680, initializes its countdown to twice the supplied duration, its blend weight to 1.0, and its per-tick delta to -1/(2*duration), then clears that channel's bit in D_002B91E8. func_00108548 consumes the records while constructing per-channel render packets and decreases the blend weight to zero. All 16 JP calls are in copies of the same ew31.ard event and fade even-numbered channels 2, 4, 6, and 8 over duration 10 while command 543 fades the alternating channels in.
